messages:
Jane (Auditor): Hi team — for the ISO / SOC2 evidence pack I need artifacts from the vulnerability triage that led to RBAC changes and a KMS key rotation. Specifically: timeline of changes, who approved, k8s audit logs or CloudTrail entries linking the rolebinding updates to service accounts, and KMS envelope/key-wrapping evidence. Can you export?
Maya (SecEng): Thanks — which timeframe do you want and do you need both prod and staging?
Jane (Auditor): Shortest reasonable window that still covers the change. The auditor wants the triage window + 24h before/after. Prod first, staging if it helps.
Liam (Platform): This was the CVE-2025-4321 triage. Action on 2025-11-12: removed cluster-admin from rolebinding 'rb-model-serve', created a new role with limited perms, patched service account 'model-serving@prod'. Also rotated KMS key (proj-prod-2025-11-12) — will include key version metadata.
Sam (SRE): There was no user-visible outage. I'll pull k8s audit logs and our cloud audit trail.
Maya (SecEng): We can produce: PR link for the RBAC change, the merged approval comment (sig-auth + sec), k8s audit logs for the rolebinding edits, CloudTrail / GCP Admin Activity records showing IAM/role edits, KMS GenerateDataKey/Decrypt logs showing key version usage, and a signed manifest with file hashes.
Maya (SecEng): Example kubectl snippet I'm going to run to capture the RBAC object state:
```
kubectl --context=prod-eu get rolebinding rb-model-serve -o yaml > /tmp/evidence/rb-model-serve-20251112.yaml
kubectl --context=prod-eu get clusterrolebinding rb-model-serve -o yaml >> /tmp/evidence/cluster-rb-model-serve-20251112.yaml
```
Sam (SRE): For audit exports I'll run our script:
```
./scripts/export_evidence.sh --since 2025-11-11 --until 2025-11-13 --targets=k8s,audit,cloudtrail,kms --out=/tmp/evidence/package-20251112.tar.gz
```
Sam (SRE): This will also include the signed CloudTrail snippets and the Splunk saved-search results (query: "event.action:UpdateRoleBinding AND resource.name:rb-model-serve").
Maya (SecEng): For KMS we have CloudTrail events like Encrypt/GenerateDataKey/Decrypt. We'll include the KMS key ARN, key_id, and envelope metadata showing which key version encrypted the DEK for service account credentials.
Maya (SecEng): We'll also create a small chain-of-custody manifest with SHA256 hashes for each artifact and sign it with our compliance key. Example manifest header:
```
manifest_version: 1
author: maya@redwood
created: 2025-11-13T08:12:00Z
files:
  - rb-model-serve-20251112.yaml: sha256:3b8f9a1e...
  - cloudtrail-snippets.json: sha256:7c2d1f4b...
```
Elaine (Compliance): Good. Please redact any access tokens or full JWTs before packaging. PII shouldn't be in these logs but double-check. We'll need a Jira evidence ticket with the package link and the control mapping (ISO 27001 A.9 / SOC2 CC6 mapping).
Sam (SRE): Uploading to evidence bucket now, will generate presigned link for auditors.
deploy-bot: deploy "rbac-tighten-2025-11-12" succeeded by liam@platform at 2025-11-12T14:03:21Z :white_check_mark:
Maya (SecEng): ETA to drop the package into S3 + manifest + signed hash: ~45 minutes. I'll @Elaine when done.
Jane (Auditor): Perfect — can you include a short human-readable summary of approvals (who reviewed/approved in PR) and an explicit mapping to the control identifiers? That speeds review.
Maya (SecEng): Will do. Quick Q: do auditors need raw logs or are redacted snippets with full CloudTrail event ids sufficient? We can provide raw under NDA but default to snippets with event IDs so you can request full records if needed.
Jane (Auditor): Snippets + event ids are fine for initial review. If we need full records we'll request them.
Sam (SRE): Evidence uploaded to s3://redwood-evidence/2025/11/12/rbac-kms-20251112.tar.gz
Sam (SRE): Presigned link (expires 7d): https://presigned.example.com/evidence/rbac-kms-20251112.tar.gz?sig=XYZ123 (internal link)
Maya (SecEng): Manifest SHA256: d2f7a9c9e1b4c6a8f2a1b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4
Elaine (Compliance): I'll create the Jira ticket EVID-4123 and attach the control crosswalk (SOC2 CC6 / ISO A.9.2 mapping). Tagging the auditor.
Jane (Auditor): Thanks — I'll start the review. If anything is missing I'll open a follow-up with specific event ids. Appreciated. :thumbsup:
